method: Blog-factcheck source matching: 1 exact, 0.9 paraphrase, null unverified/not a numeric match. Scores describe presence and matching context, not independent truth or causal certainty. Retained claims checked against primary sources; original vendor figures separately checked. At most ten source pages per article.

retained_primary_claims.claim: Native record cards, configurable layout and permissions
retained_primary_claims.decision: Separates native cards from app cards; existing options first.

retained_primary_claims.claim: React UI extensions, CRM/external data and supported surfaces
retained_primary_claims.decision: App capabilities depend on configured objects/surfaces and data implementation; not every visible panel is an app card.

retained_primary_claims.claim: External fetching and Sensitive Data restriction
retained_primary_claims.decision: Configured backend/permitted URLs; apps using Sensitive Data scopes cannot use hubspot.fetch. Other technical limits are not reproduced.
31 October 2026 explicitly attributed to older announcement.
2 November removal / 1 December tooling explicitly attributed. Planning target is editorial advice.

retained_primary_claims.claim: Tracked prompts, supported engines, metrics and access differences
retained_primary_claims.decision: Current beta setup guide: data collection starts after setup, tracked prompts run daily. Standalone and Marketing Hub limits/features differ.

retained_primary_claims.claim: Current price, USD/tax context and free Grader distinction
retained_primary_claims.decision: 50 USD/month before applicable tax, checked 22 October. Grader one-time versus paid ongoing tracking. No universal cheap/easy-buy recommendation.

retained_primary_claims.claim: Pew sample, period, click rates and method
retained_primary_claims.decision: 900 US adults, March 2025 browsing; traditional-result clicks 8% with summary / 15% without, summary links 1% of summary visits. Observational Google evidence, not site-specific loss or all-engine causality.

retained_primary_claims.claim: SEO fundamentals and eligibility for Google AI features
retained_primary_claims.decision: Google requires indexing/snippet eligibility, no new AI file or special schema. No inclusion guarantee. Scoped to Google.
Prompts reflect buyer language/location; responses vary, inspect multiple days/weeks.

recommendations: Scope one card task and compare upkeep; AEO pilot uses baseline, stable prompts and useful actions. Recommendations are not delivered customer results.
limits: No live card installation, external data call, AEO account setup, paid purchase, CRM update or ranking/citation experiment. Data and prices may change after review.
